maddeler.e:
انبعثت (form VII)
# اِنْبَعَثْتُ (inbaʕaṯtu) /in.ba.ʕaθ.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# اِنْبَعَثْتَ (inbaʕaṯta) /in.ba.ʕaθ.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# اِنْبَعَثْتِ (inbaʕaṯti) /in.ba.ʕaθ.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِنْبَعَثَ (inbaʕaṯa)
# اِنْبَعَثَتْ (inbaʕaṯat) /in.ba.ʕa.θat/: third-person
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
